text: A small six-week trial of over-65s found daily walks lowered blood pressure, only in non-medicated people.
Coffee improves memory, though so far that's only shown in mice, at doses equal to eight cups a day.
One Chinese call-centre company's volunteer staff showed 13 percent more productivity working from home, mostly from fewer breaks.
A new bridge cut commuting times by four minutes on average for northern drivers, measured during school holidays.
Pooled small, mixed-quality trials suggest vitamin D prevents colds, but only in deficient people.
A four-week reading-app test improved letter recognition, not story understanding, in children who already had tutors.
In lab colonies, a pesticide at ten times field doses shortened bees' foraging trips but didn't kill colonies.
A four-day week trial of volunteer firms with no comparison group cut weekly hours only from 38 to 34.
